mapper.select: SELECT kind, SUM(status = 'queued') AS queued, SUM(status = 'queued' AND available_at <= #{now}) AS ready, SUM(status = 'leased') AS leased, SUM(status = 'leased' AND lease_until <= #{now}) AS expired, MIN(CASE WHEN status = 'queued' AND available_at <= #{now} THEN available_at END) AS oldest FROM background_job WHERE status IN ('queued', 'leased') GROUP BY kind
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM agent_run WHERE status IN ('queued', 'running', 'waiting_approval', 'cancelling') GROUP BY status
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, MIN(created_at) AS oldest FROM agent_event WHERE published_at IS NULL
